tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fills only. The main button, the selected day, the current tab underline, progress bars, focus rings. White text on it passes 6.3 to 1.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: The only green for text. Links, the current tab, verse numbers, chapter breaks, the message label. 7.2 to 1 on bg, 6.7 on soft.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Soft green fill. The streak chip, number badges, the key message box, read days, feature icon circles. Text on it uses green-text or ink.

tokens.name: halo
tokens.usage: The ring around the selected day and the hover ring on days. Graphic only.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background. Warm off white, the same ground as Stay Counter and Shuo.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the header area, the tab bar, the selected segment.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the passage. 15.0 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, dates, section labels, notes, the inactive tab. 4.7 to 1 on bg, 5.1 on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, the segmented track, the outline button border.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Round buttons like settings and back, the grey note box, the streak chip at zero, loading bars.

tokens.name: chip-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on chip. 5.7 to 1 on chip.

tokens.name: chevron
tokens.usage: Chevrons on rows and cards, future days. 3.7 to 1 on surface so the icon is visible. Always next to a text label.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: The only warning colour. Error lines, the reset button fill. 5.8 to 1 on bg.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning box. Text on it uses coral-text, 5.6 to 1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one big line on a screen. Today's reading, Journal, the first open headline, the two stats. 44 on laptops.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: 여호와께서 각 사람에게 그의 공의와 신실을 따라 갚으시리니
styles.usage: Bible verses in the passage. Line height 1.75 so long reading stays calm.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and disclosure titles, buttons, sheet titles, the month, settings values, the laptop brand.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 사울이 다윗을 쫓지만 다윗은 굴에서 사울을 살려 줍니다.
styles.usage: Summary points, the key verse, the key message, journal messages, row labels, laptop tabs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels, the key verse label, the streak chip, number badges, verse numbers, weekday letters, phone tab labels. Sentence case, no caps.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The line above the big title, journal dates, stat captions, notes and warnings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its text, like the key verse label and the verse.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a section label and its card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a stack and between journal cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and rows, the gap inside the summary.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above each section label and above a disclosure card.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin on every phone screen.

tokens.name: max-width
tokens.usage: Content width on laptops. Backgrounds run full width, content sits centered inside this.

tokens.name: narrow-width
tokens.usage: Width of picker and settings pages on laptops.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Height of the laptop top bar.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: The key message box, the grey note box, inputs, book and chapter buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and disclosure cards. Things you read.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, round buttons, days, the segmented switch. Things you tap.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected thumb of a segmented switch. The only shadow.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of the main and outline buttons.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a settings row.

tokens.name: size-disc
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a disclosure card head.

tokens.name: size-round
tokens.usage: Round settings button in the header.

tokens.name: size-day
tokens.usage: A day circle in the calendar, inside a 40 tall cell.

tokens.name: size-chevron
tokens.usage: Every chevron, right on cards, down on disclosures.
